sloka: त्वम् तु धर्मम् अविज्ञाय केवलम् रोषम् आस्थितः ।विदूषयसि माम् धर्मे पितृ पैतामहे स्थितम् ॥४-१८-४३॥
transliteration: tvam tu dharmam avijñāya kevalam roṣam āsthitaḥ ।vidūṣayasi mām dharme pitṛ paitāmahe sthitam ॥4-18-43॥

translations.english: 'One should not insult kings, nor shout at them, nor disregard them nor speak unpleasant words to them. They are gods in human form moving on this earth.
